plain: A cutting back or lowering of an amount, such as a tax or penalty

webster.text: The act of abating; the state of being abated.

more.text: Deduction, sum withdrawn, as from an account.

example.quote: But with all these abatements, the business of federal legislation must continue so far to exceed, both in novelty and difficulty, the legislative business of a single State, as to justify the longer period of service assigned to those who are to transact it.
